name: Bathyal-Karst
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in massive canyon systems. Travelers navigate by magnetic pole anomalies and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Debris from the starship crash site (colony ship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
